# harmoniq_workspace (Data Source)

A workspace with its host apps and their environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harmoniq_workspace" "checkout_team" {
  slug = "checkout-team"
}

output "host_apps" {
  value = [for h in data.harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.host_apps : h.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Workspace slug.

### Read-Only

- `allow_ephemeral_environments` (Boolean) Whether deploys may create preview environments.
- `host_apps` (Attributes List) Host apps, the default first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--host_apps))
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `retention_days` (Number) History retention in days.

<a id="nestedatt--host_apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `host_apps`

Read-Only:

- `environments` (List of String) Environment slugs.
- `is_default` (Boolean) The workspace's default host app.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Host app slug.
